faces.name: Return to the Earth
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.

faces.name: Return to the Light Realms
faces.oracleText: Return all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.

faces.name: Return to the Ranks
faces.oracleText:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Return X target creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

faces.name: Return to the Sewers
faces.oracleText: Target creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library. You create a Mutagen token. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.")

faces.name: Return Triumphant
faces.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Create a Young Hero Role token attached to it. (Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature attacks, if its toughness is 3 or less, put a +1/+1 counter on it." If you put another Role on the creature later, put this one into the graveyard.)

faces.name: Return Upon the Tide
faces.oracleText:
Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If it's an Elf, create two 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens.
Foretell {3}{B} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
